### Main questions

This document contains all of the data required for analysing the AnswerALS data.

### 2.0 Include experiment matrix

- Let's first import the counts.

```{r include = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}

analysis_path <- "final-figures/figure-5"
save_dir <- file.path(analysis_path, "rdata_files")

```

### 3.0 Imports

- Load data files 

```{r include = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}

repeat_ranges_list <- readRDS("final-figures/figure-1/rdata_files/00-repeat-ranges-introns-exons-with-mapping-to-exons-and-introns.rds")
significant_de_event_list <- readRDS("20-import-significant-events/rdata_files/02-significantly-differentially-expressed-events.rds")
rloop_ranges <- readRDS("30-sequence-analysis-of-introns/rdata_files/90-01-merged-rloop-ranges-in-differentially-expressed-introns.rds")
feature_ranges <- readRDS("05-simulated-reads-differential-profiling/rdata_files/01-all-merged-exonic-and-intronic-segments-in-genes.rds")
rloop_density_df <- readRDS("final-figures/figure-5/rdata_files/01-rloop-stats-dataframe.rds")

```

- Select significantly affected genes

```{r}

significant_de_event_df <- significant_de_event_list$significant_events
de_feature_ranges <- feature_ranges[feature_ranges$feature_id %in% significant_de_event_df$feature_ids,]
feature_ranges_with_repeats <- repeat_ranges_list$repeat_containing_ranges
repeat_ranges <- repeat_ranges_list$repeat_ranges

```

- Plot R-loop metaprofile 

```{r}

de_feature_ranges$feature_type <- ifelse(de_feature_ranges$feature_id %in% feature_ranges_with_repeats$feature_id, "repeat_containing", "non_repeat_containing")
rloop_ranges$feature_type <- de_feature_ranges$feature_type[match(rloop_ranges$feature_id, de_feature_ranges$feature_id)]
repeat_containing_rloop_ranges <- rloop_ranges[rloop_ranges$feature_type == "repeat_containing"]
repeat_containing_rloop_ranges$which_repeat <- feature_ranges_with_repeats$which_repeat[match(repeat_containing_rloop_ranges$feature_id, feature_ranges_with_repeats$feature_id)]


de_feature_ranges_with_repeats <- feature_ranges_with_repeats[
    feature_ranges_with_repeats$feature_id %in% significant_de_event_df$feature_ids & 
    feature_ranges_with_repeats$type == "intron"]
# de_repeat_ranges <- repeat_ranges[de_feature_ranges_with_repeats$which_repeat]

dist_from_start <- start(repeat_ranges)[de_feature_ranges_with_repeats$which_repeat] - start(de_feature_ranges_with_repeats)
dist_from_end <- end(de_feature_ranges_with_repeats) - end(repeat_ranges)[de_feature_ranges_with_repeats$which_repeat]

de_feature_ranges_with_repeats$within <- dist_from_start > 0 & dist_from_end > 0

within_de_feature_ranges <- de_feature_ranges_with_repeats[de_feature_ranges_with_repeats$within]



repeat_start_matrix_list <- lapply(seq_along(within_de_feature_ranges), function(x){
    message(x)
    current_feature_ranges <- within_de_feature_ranges[x]
    current_repeat_ranges <- repeat_ranges[current_feature_ranges$which_repeat]
    if((start(current_repeat_ranges) - 1000) < start(current_feature_ranges) | (end(current_repeat_ranges) + 1000) > end(current_feature_ranges)){
        return(NULL)
    }
    current_ranges <- current_repeat_ranges
    if(as.vector(strand(current_ranges)) == "+"){
        end(current_ranges) <- start(current_ranges)
        start(current_ranges) <- start(current_ranges) - 1000
        start_vector <- .return_overlap_weighted_score_between_ranges(current_ranges, bin_to = 100, repeat_containing_rloop_ranges)
    }
    if(as.vector(strand(current_ranges)) == "-"){
        start(current_ranges) <- end(current_ranges)
        end(current_ranges) <- end(current_ranges) + 1000
        start_vector <- rev(.return_overlap_weighted_score_between_ranges(current_ranges, bin_to = 100, repeat_containing_rloop_ranges))
    }
    return(start_vector)
})
names(repeat_start_matrix_list) <- names(repeat_ranges)[within_de_feature_ranges$which_repeat]
repeat_start_matrix <- do.call(rbind, repeat_start_matrix_list)

repeat_start_means <- colMeans(repeat_start_matrix)
repeat_start_df <- data.frame(position = seq(-99, 0), value = repeat_start_means)


repeat_end_matrix_list <- lapply(seq_along(within_de_feature_ranges), function(x){
    message(x)
    current_feature_ranges <- within_de_feature_ranges[x]
    current_repeat_ranges <- repeat_ranges[current_feature_ranges$which_repeat]
    if((start(current_repeat_ranges) - 1000) < start(current_feature_ranges) | (end(current_repeat_ranges) + 1000) > end(current_feature_ranges)){
        return(NULL)
    }
    current_ranges <- current_repeat_ranges
    if(as.vector(strand(current_ranges)) == "+"){
        start(current_ranges) <- end(current_ranges)
        end(current_ranges) <- end(current_ranges) + 1000
        end_vector <- .return_overlap_weighted_score_between_ranges(current_ranges, bin_to = 100, repeat_containing_rloop_ranges)
    }
    if(as.vector(strand(current_ranges)) == "-"){
        end(current_ranges) <- start(current_ranges)
        start(current_ranges) <- start(current_ranges) - 1000
        end_vector <- rev(.return_overlap_weighted_score_between_ranges(current_ranges, bin_to = 100, repeat_containing_rloop_ranges))
    }
    return(end_vector)
})
names(repeat_end_matrix_list) <- names(repeat_ranges)[within_de_feature_ranges$which_repeat]
repeat_end_matrix <- do.call(rbind, repeat_end_matrix_list)



span_df <- data.frame(repeat_id = rownames(repeat_end_matrix), 
    ssr = repeat_ranges[rownames(repeat_end_matrix)]$ssr,
    span_group = repeat_ranges[rownames(repeat_end_matrix)]$span_group)

split_by_ssr <- split(span_df$repeat_id, span_df$ssr)


ssr_repeat_start_matrix <- do.call(rbind, lapply(split_by_ssr, function(x){
    if(length(x) > 1){
        return(colMeans(repeat_start_matrix[x,]))
    }
    return(repeat_start_matrix[x,])
}))

ssr_repeat_end_matrix <- do.call(rbind, lapply(split_by_ssr, function(x){
    if(length(x) > 1){
        return(colMeans(repeat_end_matrix[x,]))
    }
    return(repeat_end_matrix[x,])
}))




current_class_df <- unique(span_df[span_df$span_group == "hexanucleotide",c("ssr", "span_group")])

repeat_start_slope_df <- do.call(rbind, lapply(current_class_df$ssr, function(x){
    message(x)
    temp_vector <- ssr_repeat_start_matrix[x,c(76:100)]
    if(mean(temp_vector) == 0 | sd(temp_vector) == 0){
        return(NULL)
    }
    pos_df <- data.frame(pos = seq(-24,0), value = temp_vector)
    lm_object <- summary(lm(data = pos_df, formula = value ~ pos))
    data.frame(ssr = x, slope = lm_object$coefficients[2,1], sig = lm_object$coefficients[2,4])
}))

repeat_start_slope_df$significant <- repeat_start_slope_df$sig < 0.05
significant_positive_ass_df <- repeat_start_slope_df[repeat_start_slope_df$significant & repeat_start_slope_df$slope > 0,]



repeat_end_slope_df <- do.call(rbind, lapply(current_class_df$ssr, function(x){
    temp_vector <- ssr_repeat_end_matrix[x,c(1:25)]
    if(mean(temp_vector) == 0 | sd(temp_vector) == 0){
        return(NULL)
    }
    pos_df <- data.frame(pos = seq(0,24), value = temp_vector)
    lm_object <- summary(lm(data = pos_df, formula = value ~ pos))
    data.frame(ssr = x, slope = lm_object$coefficients[2,1], sig = lm_object$coefficients[2,4])
}))

repeat_end_slope_df$significant <- repeat_end_slope_df$sig < 0.05
significant_negative_ass_df <- repeat_end_slope_df[repeat_end_slope_df$significant & repeat_end_slope_df$slope < 0,]

```

- Save the results for significantly associated repeats

```{r}

common_ids <- intersect(significant_positive_ass_df$ssr, significant_negative_ass_df$ssr)

interesting_repeats_df <- data.frame(ssr = common_ids, 
    pos_slope = significant_positive_ass_df$slope[match(common_ids, significant_positive_ass_df$ssr)],
    pos_sig = significant_positive_ass_df$sig[match(common_ids, significant_positive_ass_df$ssr)],
    neg_slope = significant_negative_ass_df$slope[match(common_ids, significant_negative_ass_df$ssr)],
    neg_sig = significant_negative_ass_df$sig[match(common_ids, significant_negative_ass_df$ssr)])

interesting_repeats_df$sig <- vapply(seq_len(nrow(interesting_repeats_df)), function(x){
    mean(interesting_repeats_df$pos_sig[x], interesting_repeats_df$neg_sig[x])
},1)

interesting_repeats_df$col <- "sig"
interesting_repeats_df$ssr <- factor(interesting_repeats_df$ssr, levels = interesting_repeats_df$ssr[order(-log10(interesting_repeats_df$sig), decreasing = T)])
saveRDS(object = interesting_repeats_df, file = file.path(save_dir, "03-02-slope-near-repeats.rds"))

```

- Plot repeats with significant effect


```{r}


ThePlot <- ggplot(interesting_repeats_df, aes(x = ssr, y = col))
ThePlot <- ThePlot + geom_tile(aes(fill = -log10(sig))) 
# ThePlot <- ThePlot + geom_smooth(method = "lm", formula = y ~ splines::bs(x, 5), aes(colour = repeat_class))
ThePlot <- ThePlot + scale_x_discrete("hexanucleotides")
ThePlot <- ThePlot + scale_y_discrete("significance")
ThePlot <- ThePlot + scale_fill_distiller("significance", palette = "Reds", direction = 1)
ThePlot <- ThePlot + theme_bw()
# ThePlot <- ThePlot + facet_grid(. ~ type, scales = "free")
ThePlot <- ThePlot + ggtitle("Model significance for repeats where both models are significant")
ThePlot <- ThePlot + theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    text = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 10),
    plot.background = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = "azure3",
    linetype = "dashed",
    size = 0.2))
ggsave(width = 7, height = 7, file = file.path(plot_dir, "03-04-plot-rloops-slope-significance-near-repeats-in-introns.pdf"), ThePlot)


```
